paite: "Lungkia a na paimanglouhna ding un na kiang uah hiai thute ka genta hi.
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

paite: Sinagogte ah ahon nongsak ding ua; kuapeuh nou hon that Pathian tung a thil hoih hih in akithei ding ua huai bang hun hong tung ding ahi.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

paite: Huai thilte ahih ding ua, Pa leh kei hon theih louh ziak un.
english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

paite: Hiai thute na kiang uah ka genta hi, ahun ahong tun chiang a, ka hon hilh khinta chih na theih nawnna ding un. Hiai thilte na kiang ua ka om takdih ziak in atung a ka hon hilh louh him na hi uhi.
english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

paite: "Tu in hon sawlpa kiang ah ka pai ding a noute kuamah in, koi a hoh ding? chi in na hon dong kei uh.
heading: Kha Siangthou Nasep
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

paite: Hiai thute na kiang ua ka gen ziak in na lungtang uh lungkhamna in adimzou hialta hi.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

paite: Himahleh thutak ka hon hilh ahi; ka pai nou a ding in ahoihzaw hi; ka pai keileh na kiang uah Khamuanpa ahong tung kei ding a; ka paileh bel na kiang ua hon sawl ding ka hi.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

paite: Amah ahong tun chiang in khelhna thute ah, diktatna thute ah, leh vaihawmna thute toh kisai a khovel asiamlouhdan atheisak ding hi.
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

paite: Khelhna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh, kei hon gintak louh ziak un.
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

paite: Diktatna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh; Pa kiang ah ka pai ding; nou kei na hon muh nawn tak louh ding ziak un.
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

paite: Vaihawmna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh; hiai khovel lal siam louh a apuk tak ziak in.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

paite: "Na kiang uah gen ding tampi ka nei lai a, himahleh tu in zaw na chin tadih kei uhi.
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

paite: Himahleh amah Thutak Kha ahong tun chiang in, thutak tengteng ah nou ahon pi ding; ama phuahtawm in thu agen kei dia; azak peuhmah agen zaw ding, thil hong tung dingte leng nou ahon theisak ding hi.
english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

paite: Ama'n kei ahon pahtawi ding a; kei a ala ding a, nou kiang ah ahon theisak ding hi.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

paite: Pa'n thil aneih tengteng kei a ahi; huaiziak in kei a ala ding a, na kiang uah ahon theisak ding, ka chi hi.
english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

paite: "Sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding ua; sawt louchik mah in na hon mu nawn ding uh," achi hi.
heading: Mangpha Khakna Thute
english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

paite: Anungzuite khenkhat in, i kiang ua athugen bang ahi, sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding uh, sawt louchik mah in na hon mu nawn ding uh achih leh Pa kiang a ka hoh dek ziak in, achih? akichi uhi.
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

paite: Amau mah in, sawt louchik, achih bang chihna ahia? Athugen i theisiam kei uh, achi uhi.
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

paite: Huan amah dot ut anei uh chih Jesu'n athei a, akiang uah, "Sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding uh, sawt louchik mah in nou kei na hon mu nawn ding uh chi a ka thugen na kidong uh maw?
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na khitui uh ake ding a, na kap huphup ding uh, khovel bel akipak ding; na lungkham ding ua, himahleh na lungkham uh kipahna asuak ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

paite: Numei nau nei ding in avei lai in alungkham nak hi, ahun atun tak ziak in; himahleh nau asuahtak in alunggimna athei nawnta kei hi, khovel a naungek hong pian a akipah ziak in.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

paite: Tu in nou na lungkham uh; himahleh ka hon mu nawn ding a, na lungtang uh akipak ding, na kipahna uh kuamah in hon laksak kei ding hi.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

paite: Huai ni chiang in nou kei bangmah na hon ngen kei ding uh. Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Pa kiang a bangpeuh ka min a na nget uleh ahon pe ding hi.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

paite: Tutan in ka min in bangmah na ngen nai kei uh. Ngen un, huchi in na mu ding uh, na kipah uh akimna ding in.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

paite: "Huai thute ahem in na kiang uah ka genta hi; ahun atung dekta, huai hun chiang in na kiang uah ahem in thu ka gen nawnta kei ding a, chiantak in Pa tanchin ka hon hilh ding hi.
heading: Khovel Tung A Vualzohna
english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

paite: Huai ni chiang in keimah min in thil na ngen ding uh; Pa kiang ah ke'n ka hon ngetsak ding ka chi kei hi.
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

paite: Pa in amah ngei in noute ahon it ngal a, nou kei na hon it ua, Pa a kipan ka hi chih na hon gintak ziak un.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

paite: Kei Pa kiang a kipan hong pawt a, khovel a hong pai ka hi a; khovel paisan a, Pa kiang a pai nawn ding ka hi,” achi hi.
english: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

paite: Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, tu in teltak in na genta, ahem in na genta kei hi! achi uhi.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

paite: Nang bangkim na thei a, kuamah hon dot na kiphamoh kei chih tu in ka theita uh; hiai ziak in Pathian kiang a kipan hong pai na hi chih ka gingta uhi," achi uhi.
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a akiang uah, "Tu in na gingta uh maw?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

paite: Ngai un, ahun hong tung ding ahita, tu in leng atung lellel hi, huai hun chiang in noumau inn chiat ah na dalh vek ding ua, keimah kia na hon nuse ding uh. Himahleh ka kiang a Pa a-om ziak in keimah kia in ka om kei hi.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

paite: Hiai thute na kiang uah ka genta hi, keimah a na khamuanna ding un. Khovel ah gimthuakna na nei ding uh, himahleh khamuangtak in om un, ke'n khovel ka zouta,” achi hi.
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
